headline: Torino's winning run meets a Monza side that won here
summary: Torino host Monza on Friday after a 3-0 win at Parma. Monza answered with 4-0 at home to Cagliari, their first clean sheet of the season, and Gazzetta dello Sport reports Gustavo Varela has 6 league goals, joint-second in Serie A. Monza also won 1-0 at this stadium in the Coppa Italia in September, the most recent meeting. Torino defender Fortini is doubtful with a thigh injury, and Monza average 1.98 expected goals a game. That is why the market makes Torino 44.2% favourites, with Monza at 27.7%, and the goals line at 2.5 with 49.1% over.
read: Torino are the home favourites at 44.2%, but only just — the market rates them about a third of a goal better than a Monza side that won 4-0 on Sunday and beat them 1-0 at this stadium in the Coppa Italia last month. The goal line sits at 2.47, so the picture is a close, moderately open game rather than a home procession.

facts.fact: Torino are the home favourites at 44.2% fair probability, with Monza at 27.7%.
facts.meaning: Less than a coin-flip for the home side: the market sees a close game, not a home procession.

facts.fact: Torino won 3-0 at Parma on Sunday, their second straight Serie A win, with Giovanni Simeone scoring twice and Che Adams heading in.
facts.meaning: They come into Friday's home game on their best run of the season.

facts.fact: Monza hammered Cagliari 4-0 on Sunday, their first clean sheet of the season.
facts.meaning: The away side arrives with its biggest win of the campaign and a revived back line.

facts.fact: Gustavo Varela has scored six goals in six Serie A appearances this season, joint-second in the scoring charts.
facts.meaning: Monza's main threat arrives in the hottest scoring form of anyone on the pitch.

facts.fact: Monza won 1-0 at Torino in the Coppa Italia on 1 September this season.
facts.meaning: The most recent meeting at this stadium went to the visitors, which frames Friday as anything but a mismatch.

facts.fact: Monza average 1.98 xG per game over their last five, and have topped 1.5 xG in every one of those matches.
facts.meaning: The underdog is creating more clear chances than the favourite, which is why the market's gap between them stays small.

facts.fact: Torino defender N. Fortini, who has played 357 league minutes in six appearances, is listed doubtful with a thigh injury and was again left out of the squad at Parma.
facts.meaning: A regular in the back line is uncertain, and Torino already reshuffled there on Sunday with Ismajli coming in for Ricardo Rodríguez.

facts.fact: Five more Monza players were added to the injury list this week, including defender Y. Maye — the most used of them has 131 league minutes.
facts.meaning: The depth is thinner, but the starting XI is largely untouched, with Maye and E. Zeballos the only ones with meaningful pitch time.

sources.fact: Torino won 3-0 at Parma, their second consecutive victory, with Giovanni Simeone scoring twice and Che Adams heading in.
Fortini is again absent from Torino's squad for the trip to Parma, according to the convocati list.
Ardian Ismajli came into the Torino defence against Parma, with Ricardo Rodríguez dropping to the bench.
Zanotti has been appointed referee for Torino's Serie A Week 8 match.
Torino are described as continuing their good run after the 3-0 win at Parma.
Monza hammered Cagliari 4-0, with Gustavo Varela scoring twice and Noel Törnqvist keeping their first clean sheet of the season.
Gustavo Varela has scored six goals in six Serie A appearances this season, making him joint-second top scorer.
Monza coach Ivan Juric, speaking after the 4-0 win over Cagliari, warned Torino to expect Monza to play "as in the Coppa".
